reference.role: User-approved simplified formation subjects; strengthen Dong Ho woodblock execution

jobs.label: Brace spears
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent raster formation icon for a Vietnamese historical strategy game. The attached board is a REFERENCE for the approved simplified subject and composition, not an image to reproduce as a whole. The user approves the simple weapon/sign silhouettes but specifically wants a stronger DONG HO Vietnamese folk woodblock art character. Render the icon with a substantial warm soot-black key-block contour, irregular hand-carved curves and tapering ink cuts, broad matte natural yellow-ochre and cinnabar pigment blocks, restrained pigment misregistration just inside the contour, and sparse tactile woodblock grain within the colored areas. It should feel like an actual small Dong Ho hand print. Keep very few large shapes and only the essential cuts: no illustrative or ornamental complexity. Flat pigment fills, no gradients or dimensional lighting. Subject: only the FIRST large motif from the reference: THREE vertical bamboo-shaft spears in a close straight rank. Three substantial leaf-shaped dark iron heads above thick ochre shafts, each with at most two dark bamboo joints. One spare ivory carved cut inside each leaf head. Keep all three spears parallel and of the same height, separated clearly, no connecting crossbar. Strong tall compact silhouette with a warm folk-print character. Output exactly ONE centered isolated icon occupying about 80 percent of a square image, with genuine transparent alpha background and open transparent gaps. No background paper rectangle, text, label, repeated small samples, frame, circular seal, flourish, decorative patterns, scenery, soldiers, human figures, faces, hands, helmets or armor. Preserve the approved silhouette and historical object. The icon must be readable at 24–30 pixels; bold lines and clean generous negative space matter more than small detail.
